author: Inside Edition
description: Chuck Norris was rushed to a hospital in Hawaii where he lived on the island of Kauai two days ago. Reports say he was in good spirits following the undisclosed health emergency, but his health took a dramatic and sudden turn for the worst. Norris' family announced the legendary actor's passing on social media. Norris was a husband and father of five. Norris regularly shared videos of his life in Hawaii.
title: Action Icon Chuck Norris Dies At 86 Following Health Emergency: Family

author: Inside Edition
description: Former reality TV star Joseph Duggar faces child molestation charges that threaten to send him to jail for decades. The accusations are splitting his family. "We strongly condemn abuse. Our hearts go out to the juvenile victim of this unspeakable crime," his sister, Jill, said about the allegations. Authorities say the alleged abuse happened in Florida in 2020. Joseph's brother, Josh, who is currently serving a 12-year sentence for downloading child porn, is expressing support for his brother.
title: Joseph Duggar's Arrest Splits The Famed Duggar Family

author: Inside Edition
description: Dr. Gerhardt Konig is accused of trying to murder his wife Arielle on a hiking trail in Hawaii, then beating her with a rock and trying to inject her with a syringe when she fought back. Konig's wife survived but had severe facial injuries. She is expected to testify next week that the doctor attacked her when she refused to pose for a selfie on the cliff edge. Dr. Konig is claiming his wife was having an affair with a co-worker and attacked him.
title: Husband Accused Of Attempting To Murder Wife, Wife To Testify In Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Kathy Ireland went from supermodel to super mogul when she launched "Kathy Ireland Brands," a licensing company that includes clothing, which she sells on HSN, furniture, luggage and jewelry, in a reported $420 million empire. But in a new lawsuit, the 63-year-old Ireland claims her longtime business partners swindled her out of more than $100 million and left her with "staggering debt" and "missing funds." Inside Edition spoke to Ireland's attorney, Jill Basinger.
title: Kathy Ireland Claims Business Partners Swindled Her Out Of $100M

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump's meeting with Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi at the White House is causing stir after Trump's Pearl Harbor joke. Takaichi did not respond to Trump's reference to the attack that killed more than 2,000 Americans. Some criticized Trump saying he should not have revived a painful World War II chapter so casually. Others directed their anger at Takaichi, saying she should have spoken up.
title: Outrage After Trump's Pearl Harbor Joke Next To Japan's Prime Minister

author: Inside Edition
description: A bare-chested hotel guest walked down a corridor with a flamingo in his arms at the Flamingo Hotel in Las Vegas. Police say a drunken guest stepped into the hotel's off-limits flamingo garden and absconded with a bird to his hotel room. A hotel worker managed to bring the flamingo back. Police say when they went up to the guest's room, they found "multiple small pink-colored feathers." Cops say Mitchell Fairbairn has been charged with animal abuse.
title: Man Charged With Animal Abuse After Taking Flamingo, Police Say

author: Inside Edition
description: Bells and chimes make up the music at the gatherings of this club in New York City. Appropriately called Belles and Chimes, it's a club for women who enjoy a game of good, old fashioned pinball. Some of them could be considered obsessed. Kate Martin has dedicated the last 15 years of her life, along with much of her home's square footage, to this classic arcade game, which she says she's still getting better at. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Women's Pinball Club In NYC Thrives On Friendly Competition

author: Inside Edition
description: Missing American college student James Gracey is believed to have been found dead in Spain.
title: What Happened To University Of Alabama Student James Gracey? #shorts
